summary: Etoiles Capital Group filed a Form 6-K reporting the August 1, 2026 resignation of independent director Heung Ping Wong for personal reasons, with no dispute with the board. Concurrently, the board appointed Nancy Yang as independent director, compensation committee chair, and audit/nominating committee member, with annual compensation of HK$12,000. Yang, a U.S. citizen, was deemed independent and an audit committee financial expert. The appointment aligns with a previously disclosed plan to have about half the board be U.S.-based. The filing includes the independent director agreement as Exhibit 10.1. What to watch: further U.S.-background board appointments to complete the planned restructuring.
